notes:
## New features
- Results › assessments. A switch at the top of the Results tab adds three assessments to the receptor table, each set up from a compact panel beside it and saved with the project:
  - **BS 4142:** background LA90 (one default, or double-click a receptor's cell to enter its measured value), acoustic character corrections (tonality, impulsivity, intermittency, other), rating level, rating − background and the clause 11 initial estimate, colour-coded.
  - **Internal (BS 8233):** window (partially open −15 dB, or closed with your glazing Rw + Ctr), room type and the Table 4 criterion, with the margin.
  - **Max levels:** LAFmax at each receptor from each source's maximum sound power, the loudest event and the internal level against the 45 dB night guideline. Maxima are not added together.
- Point and area sources have a new **Max event LWAFmax** input in Noise inputs. The DataKustik 2025 padel court entry fills in 100 dB automatically.
- Settings › Appearance: the source and receptor Outline, Plan size and 3D size rows have a link between them. Linked (the default), changing one changes both. Click the chain to set them separately; the choice is remembered.
- Switching Contours › Colours between Bands and Gradient now animates. The colour strip wipes from one to the other behind a soft, shimmering edge, and the level numbers fade across.
- Double-click the logo on the sheet preview to open Settings › Organisation.
- **Report pack** (File › Export › Report Pack…): one dated folder for the report. It holds every contour sheet as a compact image, receptor results with each assessment and its basis (method, settings, criteria and clause references) in one workbook, the model input appendix, and a contents list with file sizes.
- **3D looks:** the 3D Environment popover opens with a Look picker. Working, Client presentation, Clay model and Report figure each set lighting, render quality and building colours in one click. Adjust anything and it becomes Custom; the look is saved with the project.
- Excel export from Results includes exactly the columns shown. In an assessment it adds an Assessment basis sheet.

## Changes
- **Smaller Word reports.** Copied and exported sheets and 3D views are compressed for reports: JPEG at quality 90 without chroma subsampling, so lines and small text stay sharp, tagged 300 dpi. PNG is kept when it is no bigger. Each figure stays within about 1 MB: quality and then size step down only when needed. A typical sheet drops from 2.5 MB to 0.9 MB, so a report with eight figures stays under about 8 MB. On macOS a copied sheet goes to the clipboard as the compact JPEG, and also as rich text with the JPEG embedded, which is how Office copies pictures. Export offers "Image for reports – compact JPEG" first; PNG, PDF and SVG are still available.
- **dB labels are sized in points on the sheet**, on the same basis as the side panel's text. A 7 pt label is 7 pt in the preview, the export and print, at any screen or export resolution. Auto is 6.5 pt, matching the side panel's body text. Sizes set in earlier versions are converted so exported sheets look exactly as before.
- **Minor isolines** are traced on SmartSmooth's field mesh, the same one the major lines use. They follow the majors smoothly up to façades instead of rippling every grid cell.
- **Faster SmartSmooth:** building SmartSmooth geometry is about a third faster (21 s → 14 s on a 57,000-triangle site), with bit-identical results.
- Building display settings (name and height labels, plan colours and pattern) no longer mark results out of date. Results calculated with earlier versions stay current.
- Sheet side-panel text is consistent. The title, card labels and section headings share one colour, and all body text (values, project reference, key, legend and footer) shares one grey. The title is no longer near-black and is a size smaller in Client presentation. Colours you have chosen yourself are kept.
- Older projects now show the logo, typeface and consultant titles from Settings › Organisation. Previously each project kept a copy of the logo from when it was created.
- Settings reopens where you left it: Project or Preferences, and the page within each.
- Choosing SmartSmooth sets Detail to 8×. At Raw, minor isolines broke into fragments and band edges stepped.
- In Sheet › Detailed layout, only one section is open at a time.
- An outline of 0 now means no outline on point sources and receptors, everywhere. It shows as "None" in Settings.
- The reset icon is redrawn as a clear counter-clockwise arrow.
- The Bands / Gradient switch is taller.
- The sheet picker has moved from the top of the Contours panel to the top of the Sheet tab. Only the run list stays pinned above the tabs.
- Fill, line and minor-isoline opacity step by 10 % with the − / + buttons. Any value can still be typed.
- The Sheet tab's Map area buttons (Capture view, Match editor view) are removed. The sheet area frame (pan, resize, lock) defines what the sheet captures.
- The sheet style menu is labelled Options, so it is not confused with the sheet's own Manage menu.
- Sheet controls that the current sheet layout never used are removed: logo position, calculation status, footer layout and compact footer, legend units and maximum bands.

## Bug fixes
- Vertical sections missed barrier shadow lines: the level jump behind a barrier was smeared over a grid cell. A barrier's crest now casts its exact shadow line, as building roofs did, for sources both in and off the section plane.
- In a vertical section, the Map tab's basemap control stayed enabled although sections have no basemap.
- Very busy images (dense aerial photography) could fail to compress for export.
- dB labels, contour lines and symbols on the sheet preview were a different size from the export (most visibly on non-Retina screens and while panning). The preview now shows exactly what the export will be.
- Contours › Line width, and the minor isoline Every / Width / Opacity fields, stayed greyed out after visiting Gradient, or once disabled, even when they applied.
- Sheet › Logo switch did nothing.
- Switching Show Sound level or Show Objects off and on again in Detailed layout left the contour scale or object key hidden. Their detail settings then appeared to do nothing.
- Floating side panel: the frosted, opacity, corner and divider controls did nothing. Corner rounding now scales the corner instead of switching it on or off.
- An outline of 0 was drawn as 1 pt in the plan, the sheet key and the inspector.
- A rounded neatline left the square map showing outside its corners, in the sheet preview, while panning and in exports. The corners are now clean.
- A floating side panel was cut off after the first cards, losing the contour scale, object key and footer. It is now sized to its real content.
